summary: Exporter preserves inexact times with one aggregate warning; all final VM checks pass.
body:
Changed [export.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs) and [export/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/export/crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs). Existing lib.rs/mod.rs dispatch changes remain untouched.

API remains:
```rust
pub(crate) fn export(p: &Project, seq_id: ItemId, opts: &ExportOptions, report: &mut Report) -> Result<String>
```

Implementation:
- `seconds(Tick) -> Result<Secs>` returns text and signed tick error. Exact conversions retain their previous representation; inexact conversions choose the nearest of the three candidate doubles, ties downward.
- `Xml::time` and `Xml::append` accumulate counts and maximum absolute error for written attributes. Export emits one precision warning.
- Removed precision rejection from **9 former skip/suppression sites**: interval windows, video duration, optional audio duration, animation keys, source times, nested clocks, transition duration, audio times, and markers. Invalid-value and integer-arithmetic checks remain.
- `Exporter::interval` skips and reports intervals whose written endpoints collapse.

Design: the XSD introduction defines seconds as `xs:double`; `durationType` caps project duration at 1,000,000 seconds. The integrator’s policy resolves the precision ambiguity. No other mapping or version-selection changes: ordinary constructs remain 1.0; markers/captions require 1.1 under V1, transitions under V3. No code borrowed and no dependencies added.

TDD log (test names prefixed `scene_export_`):
- First red: 25 passed, 5 failed. `full_duration_nearest_or_exact` failed the layer-presence assertion; `large_frame_precision_regression`, `unrepresentable_tick_is_explicit`, and `seconds_range_and_nearest` received errors; `collapsed_interval_is_reported` lacked the collapse warning. Corrected the boundary test to use the existing symmetric reader range.
- Second red: 25 passed, 10 failed. Added `inexact_asset_duration`, `inexact_source_and_animation`, `inexact_nested_clock`, `inexact_transition`, and `inexact_audio_and_metadata`; each failed because its expected XML node was absent.
- Green: **35/35 exporter tests passed**. The full-range property checks retained layers, errors ≤64 ticks, positive intervals, and warning presence exactly when needed. The fixed regression reports exactly 3 inexact attributes, maximum error 1 tick. Every exported test document passes read and validation.

Final VM results: **fmt passed; clippy with -D warnings passed; 158 tests passed (99 unit, 59 integration); wasm passed for 50 crates**. [VM log](/tmp/filmcraft-export-precision-final-vm.log).

Integrator notes: no exhaustive Format matches outside scope need repair. Engine format parsing accepts Scene through Format::ALL; menus do not add it automatically. S8 still needs the extension allowlist at engine/src/interchange.rs:13, command/menu wiring at engine/src/commands.rs:1475, and import filter at ui-egui/src/lib.rs:1276. Import remains intentionally stubbed; round-trip tests remain deferred.

Task completed and locks released. No local builds/tests, commits, or pushes.
